cohort: 150 women aged 20-40 years presenting with non-reactive cardiotocography, excluding those with multiple gestation, fetal anomaly, or admitted for elective caesarean section.
finding: Non-reactive cardiotocography is associated with adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the mode of delivery for 60% of the patients.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 53.33% of the neonates.
